GameOptions.Expansions.BetaPannel: Test your wits against various AI archetypes like the Trickster, The Warlord or the Monster Hunter! Want to play against other players worldwide? Or invite your friends to the doors of Valhalla?
GameOptions.Expansions.GodsOfAsgard.Deta: The combination of the two gods used in each game creates a unique texture to that session. They affect draft choices and influence the flow of the battles. Will you try to benefit from a god's power again and again by moving him where you want and always pillaging his province? Or will you do your best to neutralize him by pillaging around his province? Perhaps you'll want to attempt a hopeless pillage on his province just to move him onto another province where he will hinder another player's plans. They add a whole new layer to the game, without adding hardly any complexity to the rules.
GameOptions.Expansions.GodsOfAsgard.Info: Invite the Gods of Asgard down to Midgard to witness the slaughter! Each god brings their own special rukles with them to be observed, while they are entertained by your antics.
Mystics are special units (neither Warrior nor Monster) that players can only employ once they've given their clan one of the Mystic Clan Upgrades. Each of these Clan upgrades adds 1 Mystic figure to your clan's reserves, which you can then use to Invade and battle normally. 
Besides adding Mystics to your reserves, each of these Clan Upgrades grants your Mystics a special ability. If you collect several different upgrades, each of your Mystics will posses all the abilities you accumulated, making them incredibly resourceful and strategic additions to your clan!
Known by many names and possessed of powers granted by their connection to the gods, these warrior-shamans will be a boon to any clan able to recruit them!

LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip1: Using the March action is generally the only way to get your figures to Yggdrasil, since you can't normally invade Yggdrasil.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip10: Remember that for each fight you win, you need to discard a card (if you still have any). So make sure you can afford to lose the cards you have.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip2: There are no villages in Yggdrasil, so there is no limit to the number of figures you can have there.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip3: Be aware of the danger of your opponent playing Loki's Trickery and only have 1 Rage left, thus ending your turn.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip4: When you have 0 remaining Rage, you can use Loki's Trickery to gain 1 Rage, and be back in the game.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip5: Frigga's Protection can be a powerful insurance against Odin's Tide!
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip6: By starting a fight, you can move your figures via 'Call to Battle' for free.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip7: In bigger games, be aware that your opponent's might play multiple copies of Loki cards, resulting in huge losses of Rage or Glory.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip8: Keep in mind that many of the Warrior upgrades also increase the cost of your Warriors.
LoadingScreen.Hint.Tip9: When keeping powerful figures like the Troll or Soldier of Hel in reserve, beware of your figure limit and be sure that you can still place figures.

PlayerProfile.ClansHelpText:
Here you can sort the clans into a personal ranking. When starting a game, we will try and give you your highest-ranking clan - if that's not possible, the second highest one, and so forth.
Note that there never is a guarantee to get your favourite clan. But we try our best.

Settings.AutoZoomHint:
Enabling the feature will mean that the game auto-zooms to an enemy figure when it takes an action.
This is a good option if you like to be aware of everything that your opponents do.
Settings.FastBattleModeHint: This option will enable faster battle animations, speeding the game up, especially meant for players who are familiar with the flow of it.

Settings.UseAzertyKeyboardHint: Enabling this will adjust the keyboard controls to fit the AZERTY-Keyboard layout.
